---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Angel Frias"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot
storms |>
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(
    title = "Count of Storms by Status Each Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Status"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-storms
#| cache: true
storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: pressure-vs-wind
storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Atmospheric Pressure and Wind Speed",
    subtitle = "Atlantic storms from 2000 onward show an inverse relationship across storm statuses",
    x = "Sustained Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Atmospheric Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  )
```
